script: Spread and total were not saved, so the script is form-only, and weather was not saved either. LA's last three games are a Davante Adams air game (29 targets, 358 yards, 498 air yards) beside a Kyren Williams/Blake Corum carry split (38/214 and 28/148), and Matthew Stafford is +0.22 EPA/dropback with no blitz versus -0.23 against one (n=39). PHI has been DeVonta Smith (27 targets, 235 yards, 323 air yards) and Dontayvion Wicks (15/179/203 air) through the air, with Saquon Barkley (34/174) and Jalen Hurts (14/89) sharing the ground, and Hurts at -0.14 EPA vs blitz (n=37) and -0.02 without it. Inferred script: LA can throw because PHI blitzes only 26% and has allowed 8 passes of 20+ on 92 attempts, while PHI's skill players run into a tighter LA pass defense (5 passes of 20+ on 105 attempts, 6 runs of 10+).
who_goes_off: Davante Adams is the one who should go off: 358 receiving yards on 29 targets over three games, 119.3 yards per game, against a 60.5 line, with 498 air yards aimed at a PHI defense allowing 7.25 YPA in the middle and 7.21 to the left. Kyren Williams is the LA back actually producing (214 rush yards on 38 carries, 5.63 YPC, plus 106 receiving yards on 12 targets), not Blake Corum's 28/148 as the lead. Puka Nacua is not in that tier on this sheet — 9 targets and 74 yards — behind Adams, Tyler Higbee (13/74), K.Williams, T.Ferguson (12/63) and K.Mumpfield (11/105).
weak_spot: PHI's real leak is the middle and the left, not a vague outside-CB story: middle 7.25 YPA on 24 attempts, left 7.21 on 24, right a tighter 6.18 on 40 attempts, plus 8 passes of 20+ on 92 attempts and 4.09 rush YPC with 8 runs of 10+. That middle/left window is the Adams matchup. LA is the stingier unit — left 5.25 YPA on 44 attempts, middle 4.89 on 18, right 5.34 on 38, only 5 passes of 20+ on 105 attempts, 4.00 rush YPC but just 6 runs of 10+ — so Wicks' 179 yards on 15 targets and Barkley's 5.12 YPC do not get the same explosive runway.
injury_fallout: No injury report was saved, so fallout is only the usage already on the sheet. On LA, Davante Adams has 29 targets and 358 yards while Puka Nacua has 9 targets and 74 yards, Tyler Higbee 13/74, T.Ferguson 12/63 and K.Mumpfield 11/105 — the ball is not finding Nacua. On PHI, Dallas Goedert is at 7 targets and 81 yards, Johnny Mundt 4/12, and Saquon Barkley 6 targets for 6 yards with -3 air yards, so the pass volume is DeVonta Smith (27/235) and Dontayvion Wicks (15/179), with Hurts' 14 carries for 89 yards cutting into Barkley's 34 carries.
qb_vs_blitz: Matthew Stafford is -0.23 EPA/dropback vs blitz on 39 dropbacks and +0.22 with no blitz; PHI's blitz rate is 26%, so most of his dropbacks should land in the +0.22 split, which is the Adams environment rather than a heat script. Jalen Hurts is -0.14 vs blitz on 37 dropbacks and -0.02 without a blitz; LA blitzes 27%, so he is slightly worse when they heat him and has no positive split, which caps PHI explosives against a defense that has allowed only 5 passes of 20+ on 105 attempts.

picks.why: Adams has 358 yards on 29 targets over three games (119.3 per game, 12.3 yards per target, 498 air yards) against a 60.5 line at -113. PHI blitzes only 26%, and Stafford is +0.22 EPA without a blitz versus -0.23 against one, so the dropbacks match the split where LA's passing works, into a defense allowing 7.25 YPA in the middle, 7.21 to the left, and 8 passes of 20+ on 92 attempts.

Nacua has 9 targets and 74 yards over those same three games, 24.7 yards per game, against a 76.5 line at -113. The targets are already spent — Adams 29, Higbee 13, Williams 12, T.Ferguson 12, K.Mumpfield 11 — so 76.5 needs a role this sheet does not show, even though PHI's middle (7.25 YPA on 24 attempts) is leaky enough for the receiver who actually has the 498 air yards.
